title: A six-photo album turn completes and logs, never a cut-off dump
replays: The 31 Oct class: a six-photo album failed after 3m56s with a cut off notice. The turn now stays inside the output budget and completes.

steps.text: Here are six photos from my lunch today. Photo 1: a bowl of tomato soup. Photo 2: half a grilled cheese sandwich. Photo 3: the second sandwich half. Photo 4: a small side salad. Photo 5: a pickle spear. Photo 6: a glass of lemonade. Log the whole meal as lunch.
